Workers Paid was confirmed at deploy; this step only onboards the domain for Email Sending.

Section heading.
Connecting to Workers Builds makes every push to the default branch deploy itself.
Command: run create-cairn-site with --dir and --connect.
The connect step works once the site is live, with or without a domain.

The second token has eight permissions: the five plus three for Workers Builds.
The token becomes the build token given to every build; treat default-branch committers as able to read it.

Two browser moments: the token page, and a sign-in click for the config commit under your name.
